metadata.description: Marketplace for human, a prose style-budget enforcer for Claude Code. Measures the markdown and git text an agent writes against published, sourced budgets. It does not judge who wrote the text.

plugins.name: human
plugins.description: Enforces a published prose style budget on the markdown and git text an agent writes. Deterministic checks with zero model calls in the hook path, per-artifact register routing, and a stated confidence level and source on every rule.
